summary: Mills Music Trust filed an 8-K reporting a quarterly distribution to unit holders. The trust received $225,863 ($0.8133 per unit) from Sony Music Publishing as a contingent portion payment for Q1 2026 royalty income, compared to $202,850 ($0.7304 per unit) in Q1 2025. After paying $132,540 to advisors, the trust distributes $93,323 ($0.3361 per unit) to holders of record as of June 23, 2026. This is a routine periodic distribution, not a special situation event. No structural changes, tender offers, or strategic actions are announced.
